title: Report on the technical review of the eighth national communication and the fifth biennial report of Belarus
organization: United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change expert review team
temporal_coverage: Reviews Belarus's NC8 and BR5 submissions for 2022; expert review held in October 2023.
methodology: Full 37-page UNFCCC expert technical review; cited claims are what Belarus reported in NC8/BR5, not new independent monitoring.
limitations: NC8 reporting summarized by the expert review team; plans described in 2022–2023 are not verified after publication.

title: Towards Water Security in Belarus: A Synthesis Report
organization: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
temporal_coverage: Historical river records through 2015; local water-system data mainly from 2018–2019; selected projections through 2035.
methodology: Opened the English report; reviewed hydrology, regional cases and Kopyl.
limitations: Synthesis uses older local datasets; the cited 2035 projection has no emissions pathway.

title: Climate Change and Security in Eastern Europe: Regional Assessment
organization: Environment and Security Initiative (OSCE, UNDP, UN Environment, UNECE and REC)
temporal_coverage: Regional assessment based on desk review and consultations in 2014 and 2016; published 2017.
methodology: Opened the full 51-page regional assessment; it combines desk studies, national consultations and joint analyst review.
limitations: Published 2017; evidence mixes desk studies and expert consultation and does not establish a violent event caused by climate.

title: Peatland rehabilitation as a response to drought and sand storms in Belarus: Experience of UN Convention to Combat Desertification
organization: United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification
temporal_coverage: Reports local climate and land conditions and peatland activities from 2017–2020, with later project targets as announced in 2020.
methodology: Read the full UNCCD library article by Jamal Annagylyjova, including reported local cases and project status.
limitations: Partner article, not an independent evaluation; completed work and second-phase targets are status as reported in 2020.

title: Adapting to the Unpredictable: Belarusian Farmers Navigate the Consequences of Climate Change
organization: United Nations Development Programme in Belarus
temporal_coverage: Country climate context and a Brahin district farm case, published in 2024.
methodology: Read the full UNDP Belarus story and project description; used only the Brahin farm case.
limitations: One human-interest farm story, not a representative sample or an impact evaluation.
